[P2] Include default-client execution in the validation plan

Every added Lambda and SageMaker functional test injects a fake `client`; the missing-package tests fail before reaching default client creation. Consequently, the documented usage without `client` has no coverage of construction or reuse. Neither transport receives the runnable examples/integration coverage required by root AGENTS.md, and the existing live tests cover HTTP and Bedrock only. Return to the design phase with validation covering these default paths and examples for both transports, satisfying CONTRIBUTING rule 4 and the public-feature testing requirements.
